query.text: 我是听障人士，请帮我盯着烤箱定时器，到时间了提醒我。
query.text_en: I am hearing impaired, please help me keep an eye on the oven timer and remind me when the time is up.

annotation.text_zh: 烤箱定时已到，请注意查看。
annotation.text_en: The oven timer went off, please check on it.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
